info.name: CourtKu API
info.description: The API behind CourtKu: venues, courts, prices, live availability, bookings and online payments for badminton, futsal and pickleball courts in Malaysia.

item.name: Venues (public)

GET /api/v1/venues?sport=badminton&state=selangor&q=cheras&page=2: the venues guests can book,
for the list on the home page (ADR-031). Only approved venues with at least one bookable court.

request.description: Real venues come first, then the demo venues (ADR-030); 24 per page.

item.name: GET /api/v1/venues/{slug}: everything the venue's public page shows.
GET /api/v1/venues/{slug}/courts: the courts players can book.

GET /api/v1/venues/{slug}/availability?date=2026-11-06&sport=badminton
Every bookable court offering the sport, with each half hour players can still book
and its price. Half hours that have started, or are inside the venue's notice, are left out.
POST /api/v1/venues/{slug}/quote: the total for one booking, adding up each half hour.

request.description: The booking page shows this before the player books; M3 uses the same check to book.

item.name: Bookings (players)

POST /api/v1/venues/{slug}/bookings  (header Idempotency-Key: <a random id per Book press>)
201 with the new booking; 200 with the same booking when the same key comes again
(a double tap or a network retry); 409 SLOT_TAKEN when someone was faster.
GET /api/v1/bookings/{code}: the player's own booking, e.g. for the confirmation page.

request.description:
While it waits for payment, CourtKu asks Stripe how the payment stands first (at most every few
seconds), so the status page shows "paid" as soon as Stripe knows, webhook or not.

item.name:
GET /api/v1/me/bookings?when=upcoming (soonest first) or ?when=past (latest first, with
cancelled ones), 20 at a time. The next page is ?cursor=<meta.next_cursor> (plan section 8).

POST /api/v1/bookings/{code}/cancel: the player cancels their own booking (FR-24), until the
venue's cutoff (e.g. 24 hours before). The half hours are free for others straight away.
POST /api/v1/bookings/{code}/pay: { "data": { "url": "https://checkout.stripe.com/.
Payments
POST api/v1/webhooks/payments/stripe
GET /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/payment-account: the connected account, or null.

request.description: Until it can take payments, CourtKu asks Stripe again each time, e.g. when the owner comes back from Stripe.

item.name: POST /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/payment-account/onboarding: { "data": { "url": "https://connect.stripe.com/.

DELETE /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/payment-account: CourtKu stops using the account, and players
go back to paying at the counter. The Stripe account itself stays the venue's. Refused while a
player is paying, so their payment can still be confirmed.
PUT /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/payment-settings  { "payment_mode": "both", "hold_minutes": 15 }

GET /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/payments/attention: online payments the owner should refund (FR-25),
newest first, until they are fully refunded:
  - money that came in but couldn't confirm the booking (wrong amount, too late, after a cancel, paid twice);
  - bookings paid online and cancelled afterwards (by the player before the cutoff, or by staff).

POST /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/payments/{payment}/refunds  { "amount_sen": 2000, "reason": "Paid after the time ran out" }
Part refunds are fine; the total can never be more than was paid. Fully refunded = status refunded.
Venue setup (owners)
GET /api/v1/manage/venues: the venue picker. Only venues this user belongs to.
POST /api/v1/manage/venues: list a new venue (FR-04).

request.description: It starts as pending and stays hidden until an admin approves it.

item.name: GET /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}. The route checks VenuePolicy::view first.
PUT /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}: save the profile (FR-06). Owners only (VenuePolicy::update).
PUT /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/settings: how players may book (FR-13). Owners only.
GET /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/hours
PUT /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/hours: replaces the whole week.
GET /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/closures: today's and future closures, soonest first.
POST /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/closures
GET /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/courts: in the owner's chosen order.
POST /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/courts: the new court goes at the end of the list.

PUT /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/courts/order  { "court_ids": [7, 4, 5] }
Every court of the venue, each exactly once, in the new order.
PUT /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/courts/{court}: name, indoor, active and sports.
DELETE /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/courts/{court}
GET /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/price-rules: all-courts rules first, then by start time.
POST /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/price-rules
PUT /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/price-rules/{priceRule}
DELETE /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/price-rules/{priceRule}: those hours go back to the normal price.
GET /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/staff

POST /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/staff-invites  { "email": "aina@example.com" }
Inviting the same email again sends a fresh link; the old one stops working.
DELETE /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/staff-invites/{invite}: the link stops working.
DELETE /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/staff/{user}: they lose access straight away.
GET /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/photos: in the owner's chosen order.
POST /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/photos: the new photo goes at the end.
PUT /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/photos/order  { "photo_ids": [5, 2, 3] }
DELETE /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/photos/{photo}
Day schedule (staff)
GET /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/schedule?date=2026-11-06 (today in Malaysia when left out)

request.description:
times: the day's half hours, from opening to closing, after midnight too (ADR-015), plus any
half hour a booking or block holds outside today's hours. courts: the active courts, and any
other court with a booking or block that day. bookings: everything except cancelled and expired
ones (holds still waiting for payment included).
blocks: times closed for repairs or a private event (FR-21).

item.name: GET /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/schedule/version (FR-14)

request.description:
A tiny answer the Schedule tab asks for every 10 seconds: a word that changes whenever a booking,
cancel, block or setting at this venue is saved (AvailabilityCache, ADR-028). The page reloads the
whole schedule only when it changes, so the counter sees new online bookings within seconds.

item.name: POST /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/bookings

POST /api/v1/manage/venues/{venue}/blocks
{ "court_ids": [6, 7], "starts_at": "2026-11-06T18:00:00+08:00", "minutes": 120, "reason": "Floor repair" }
One block per court, all or nothing: 409 SLOT_TAKEN (with the bookings in the way) when any
of these half hours is already booked or blocked.
